title: historical-commitment-authority-unreconstructable

proposition.statement: A consequential commitment cannot be reliably defended when the system cannot reconstruct the mandate, policy, status, approval and exact action evaluated at the original commitment time.

preconditions: A material commitment was previously admitted or denied.
A later audit, dispute or review asks what authority existed at that historical time.
One or more decision inputs or provenance references are unavailable or overwritten.

trigger.statement: The system presents current authority state or an agent explanation as though it proves the historical decision basis.

evidence_required.statement: Historical commitment/evaluation time distinct from reconstruction time.
References to the exact mandate, policy, action and decision artifacts used.
Historical authority/status evidence or an explicit statement that it cannot be established.
Approval or delegation lineage relevant to the historical decision.

falsification.condition: Current state is substituted for historical state without qualification.
Missing historical evidence is silently represented as verified historical authority.
